description: Follow-up from TKT-30 adversarial review. Add an upgrade-path integration test that starts from the pre-redeemed Access schema, applies the `redeemed` lifecycle migration, and proves issued/delivered history remains readable and redemption still works. The TKT-30 down migration intentionally fails rather than delete immutable redeemed history; this task tests the supported forward-only path.

binding.rule: Ticket lifecycle events are append-only and immutable; destructive rollback is not an allowed way to remove redeemed history.
